narrative.overview:
The portal reads as a calm institutional document that carries one Almaty-mosaic signature. Sections are white and cool-neutral pages, structured by sentence-case serif headings and hairline ledgers. Every page starts at the same left edge as the header logo. One turquoise field per group carries the main path; everything around it is quiet. Neutrals outnumber the brand colour by a wide margin, so the turquoise reads as SDU's voice and not as wallpaper.

The mosaic survives as a signature, not a wall. It appears at most twice per page: a stepped edge of 16px turquoise tesserae where the hero band rises into the campus photo, and the same profile where the footer rises into the page. The system is flat and square by conviction, with no gradients, no soft shadows and no rounded cards. Depth comes from field against neutral and from a flat 2px ink ring on floating overlays. Real SDU photography carries the warmth on the home page and the hub, including inside the main path tile; each programme page carries its own credited subject photograph. The official SDU navy and peach are not used, so the portal does not read as a copy of sdu.edu.kz.

Density follows the visitor mode. Persuade (home, programmes) uses full-bleed bands, a mosaic of unequal tiles and ledgers. Read (the admissions hub, planning guides and information pages) puts a turquoise title band over ruled lists, split ledgers and reading columns. Operate (account, application, staff) is quieter, with plain hairline containers. The world is light only, because applicants use it on phones in daylight.
keyCharacteristics: One brand hue: smalt turquoise and its deep shade on cool white, white and a light tint.
Source Serif 4 headings in sentence case at weight 500; Golos Text for everything you read.
Condensed caps only for short labels, numerals and the large action label.
Square corners, 1px hairlines, ledgers opened by a 2px ink rule.
The mosaic is one stepped 16px edge, at most twice per page.
One ochre action: Apply (and Search where the page is a search).

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Turquoise and deep turquoise are the only brand fields, set solid on cool white, white or field tint. No other hue fills a section, a tile or a decoration.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Ochre is only the primary action (the shared Apply action, and the hero and finder Search). Terracotta is only errors and destructive actions. Glacier is only selection. An ochre, terracotta or glacier tile, band or decoration is a defect. The one sanctioned use beyond that is application state: in `Badge` and `ApplicationStepper`, ochre marks "changes requested" and terracotta marks "not accepted", always as a small tile plus words, because there the colour carries meaning the applicant must act on.

rules.name: The White Marker Rule
rules.body: On turquoise, emphasis is white: the active nav underline is a 2px white bar, the active quick link is white and underlined, the selected Compare toggle on the programme band is a filled white button with turquoise text, and the globe marker is a white square. Ochre is not used to mark position or selection.

rules.name: The Not-SDU-Navy Rule
rules.body: The official SDU navy and peach are not used anywhere.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Every heading is serif, sentence case, weight 500, letter-spacing −0.01em, line-height 1.04 to 1.15. No heading is set in capitals.

rules.name: The Small Caps Voice Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps appear only in the label utility, in numerals and in the large-button and Apply labels. Anything longer than three words is not a label.

rules.name: The Heading Order Rule
rules.body: A tile or card title is never larger than its own section heading.

rules.name: The Cyrillic Air Rule
rules.body: In Kazakh and Russian, h1 to h3 take line-height 1.16 so diacritics on capitals (Ң, Қ, Ұ, Ё, Й) clear the line above. This outranks the tight leading utilities.

rules.name: The Whole Word Rule
rules.body: Headings are never hyphenated and are balanced; sizes are set so whole words fit at 360, 1024 and 1440px in KK, RU and EN. overflow-wrap is a last-resort guard only.

rules.name: The Plain Heading Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow or kicker label above a heading, and no section numbers. A real count (for example the number of programs in a degree group) may sit below a heading as content.

rules.name: The Worded Range Rule
rules.body: A range is written in words, never with a dash: "19,000 to 41,500 ₸", "от 19 000 до 41 500 ₸". A large display figure shows the lowest value under a "From" mark, and the highest goes in the line below. Official compound names that contain a dash (UNT subject pairs) keep it.

rules.name: The Full Sentence Rule
rules.body: Interface copy is written in short full sentences. No semicolons, and a ledger row has a title and one plain detail line. Levels with no published dates share one row (title "Master's and PhD", detail "Dates not published yet").

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: No gradient and no blurred shadow on any surface, tile, button or image.

rules.name: The Globe Exception
rules.body: The shaded cobe HeroGlobe in the home International band is the one sanctioned departure from the Flat Page Rule, kept as Daniyar's component. It is rendered as flat as cobe allows: diffuse 0, dark 0, glow equal to the field tint so there is no halo, and a white marker. It opens centred on Almaty and sways ±0.5 rad around it instead of spinning, so Almaty never turns away. Nothing else may copy its shading.

dos: **Do** keep turquoise and deep turquoise as the only brand fields, on cool white, white and the field tint.
**Do** reserve ochre for the shared Apply action and the hero and finder Search, terracotta for errors and destructive actions, glacier for selection.
**Do** start every page in the 84rem header frame and limit reading widths left-aligned inside it.
**Do** set headings in Source Serif 4, sentence case, weight 500, letter-spacing −0.01em, and keep tile titles smaller than their section heading.
**Do** use the label utility (condensed 600, 0.875rem, +0.08em, caps) for labels of three words or fewer, and condensed tabular figures for numerals.

**Do** keep the mosaic tile grid to the home page, with one turquoise `field` main path per group, optionally with a real SDU photo across its top; the rest are white `card` tiles. Elsewhere use ruled rows.
**Do** derive every deadline state from the Almaty calendar day (upcoming, closed, unpublished), state closed and unpublished deadlines in words, and say so plainly when the whole cycle is over.
**Do** build structure from ledgers: a 2px ink rule over 1px hairline rows, with linked-row hover hanging outside the text edge.
**Do** use the flat 2px ink ring (`--shadow-overlay`) for floating overlays only.
**Do** give Kazakh and Russian headings line-height 1.16.

**Do** keep motion to the set below; every spatial movement is gated on `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`, and hidden states only apply under `html.motion-ready`, so content never disappears without scripts.
donts: **Don't** use the mosaic signature more than twice per page, or as random, multicoloured edges or sticker clusters.
**Don't** make glacier, ochre or terracotta tiles, bands or decorations.
**Don't** set headings in capitals or in the condensed face.
**Don't** add colour stripes or dashed outlines to cards to show state, or show "Closed" and "Not published" as badges.
**Don't** add a second ochre button to a view, or use ochre for a selected state on turquoise.
**Don't** float a chat button over content on phones; use the bottom action bar.
**Don't** use gradients or soft shadows; the cobe HeroGlobe is the one sanctioned exception and nothing may copy its shading.
**Don't** put eyebrow or kicker labels above headings, or number sections.
**Don't** use the official SDU navy or peach.
**Don't** add a dark mode; the world is light only.
